coverage.summary: Statewide cap on rent increases for residential real property: any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including units in mobilehome parks. The following are exempt: housing issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years (a rolling window; mobilehomes are not exempt on this basis); housing under a valid local rent or price control that restricts annual increases below this cap; deed-restricted or subsidized affordable housing; school and university dormitories; qualifying separately alienable property with a non-corporate owner and written notice; and owner-occupied duplexes. Homeowners of mobilehomes are not covered.
coverage.owner_conditions: Separately alienable property is exempt only if the owner is not a REIT, a corporation, an LLC with a corporate member, or mobilehome park management, and the owner gave the written exemption notice. An owner-occupied duplex is exempt while the owner continues in occupancy.
coverage.other_conditions: Does not authorize local limits beyond Civ. Code ch. 2.7 (§ 1954.50 et seq.) and does not limit existing local rent-control authority. Applies to increases on or after March 15, 2019, or on or after Feb. 18, 2021 for mobilehome tenancies. Does not apply to homeowners of mobilehomes.
